name_zh: 保加利亚文化/西里尔传承：梦境时间叙事与正教文明桥梁
name_en: Bulgarian Culture/Cyril Legacy: Dreamtime Narrative & Orthodox Civilizational Bridge
description_zh: 保加利亚作为斯拉夫正教文明的摇篮，历经西里尔/梅托迪 (860s) 创造格拉哥里/西里尔字母、927 年牧首区/特尔诺沃文学学派、奥斯曼 500 年/民族复兴/1878 独立/1944 共产主义/1989 民主/2004 北约/2007 欧盟。核心文化传承：西里尔字母即民族灵魂/正教即文明锚定/口述史诗 (《迪根·阿克拉》/《米奥德拉戈》) 即历史记忆/玫瑰谷/修道院网络即精神地理。体现 M154 梦境时间叙事——以"文字创制+正教锚定+口述史诗+修道院网络"四位一体，在拜占庭/奥斯曼/苏联/欧盟四重文明冲击中实现文化连续性。
description_en: Bulgaria as cradle of Slavic Orthodox civilization, across Cyril/Methodius (860s) creating Glagolitic/Cyrillic scripts, 927 Patriarchate/Tarnovo Literary School, 500-year Ottoman/National Revival/1878 independence/1944 communism/1989 democracy/2004 NATO/2007 EU. Core cultural transmission: Cyrillic script as ethnic soul/Orthodoxy as civilizational anchor/ oral epics ('Digenis Akritas'/'Miodrag') as historical memory/Rose Valley/monastery network as spiritual geography. Exemplifies M154 Dreamtime Narrative—quaternity of 'script creation + Orthodox anchor + oral epics + monastery network' achieving cultural continuity under four-civilization impacts of Byzantine/Ottoman/Soviet/EU.
reason_zh: 保加利亚文化非单纯遗产，而是"文字即灵魂+正教即锚+史诗即史+修道院即地"四位一体文化操作系统。西里尔字母输出至俄/塞/北马其顿/蒙古，正教牧首区提供精神主权，口述史诗编码历史记忆，修道院网络(里拉/巴霍沃/罗热嫩)守护圣地。M154 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M177 因纽特生存(北极)、M178 极地气候(工程)，核心在于"文字创制文明+正教精神主权+口述史诗历史记忆"的斯拉夫文化连续性范式。
reason_en: Bulgarian culture not mere heritage but 'script as soul + Orthodoxy as anchor + epics as history + monasteries as geography' quaternity cultural OS. Cyrillic exported to Rus/Serbia/N.Macedonia/Mongolia, Orthodox patriarchate provides spiritual sovereignty, oral epics encode historical memory, monastery network (Rila/Bachkovo/Rozhen) guards sacred geography. M154 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (LatAm), M177 Inuit Survival (Arctic), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), core: 'script-creates-civilization + Orthodox spiritual sovereignty + oral epics historical memory' Slavic cultural continuity paradigm.
steps_zh: 西里尔/梅托迪文字创制：860s 格拉哥里字母/西里尔字母，斯拉夫语言首次书面化，文字成文明基因
正教牧首区与文学学派：927 牧首区/特尔诺沃/奥赫里德学派，翻译圣经/教父/古典，斯拉夫神学体系建立
奥斯曼期口述史诗存续：《迪根·阿克拉》《米奥德拉戈》吟游诗人传唱，编码反抗/英雄/信仰记忆
修道院网络守护圣地：里拉/巴霍沃/罗热嫩/特罗扬，壁画/圣像/手抄本/圣物，精神地理锚定民族魂
现代复兴与欧盟文化外交：1878 独立/复兴作家/2007 欧盟/西里尔字母成欧盟官方文字/文化遗产数字化/旅游复兴
steps_en: Cyril/Methodius script creation: 860s Glagolitic/Cyrillic scripts, Slavic languages first written, script becomes civilizational gene
Orthodox patriarchate & literary schools: 927 Patriarchate/Tarnovo/Ohrid schools, translated Bible/Fathers/classics, Slavic theological system established
Ottoman-era oral epic survival: 'Digenis Akritas'/'Miodrag' minstrels transmit, encoding resistance/heroes/faith memories
Monastery network guarding sacred geography: Rila/Bachkovo/Rozhen/Troyan, frescoes/icons/manuscripts/relics, spiritual geography anchors ethnic soul
Modern revival & EU cultural diplomacy: 1878 independence/Revival writers/2007 EU/Cyrillic becomes EU official script/heritage digitization/tourism revival
expected_zh: 以"文字创制+正教锚定+口述史诗+修道院网络"四位一体，在拜占庭/奥斯曼/苏联/欧盟四重文明冲击中实现文化连续性，西里尔字母成为斯拉夫文明共同基因，为小语种文化存续提供范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'script creation + Orthodox anchor + oral epics + monastery network' achieves cultural continuity under four-civilization impacts of Byzantine/Ottoman/Soviet/EU, Cyrillic script becomes Slavic civilizational common gene, providing small-language cultural survival paradigm.
case_zh: 860s 文字创制→927 牧首区→1393 奥斯曼灭亡/500 年统治→1878 独立/复兴→1944 共产主义/文字拉丁化尝试失败→1989 民主/西里尔字母复位→2007 欧盟/西里尔成第 3 官方文字，1100+ 年文化连续性。
case_en: 860s script creation -> 927 patriarchate -> 1393 Ottoman fall/500 yr rule -> 1878 independence/Revival -> 1944 communism/Latinization attempt failed -> 1989 democracy/Cyrillic restored -> 2007 EU/Cyrillic becomes 3rd official script, 1100+ year cultural continuity.
